Resolve all Gambit domain lookups through a custom DNS server.
Use translucent, frosted surfaces throughout Gambit.
The Gambit icon on your TV’s home screen. The launcher may take a moment to show the change.
Stage draws Gambit’s own soft colors. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Gambit logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent color. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colors.
Looks on GitHub for a newer Gambit now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favorites and settings stay as they are.
The font used across Gambit, and how large text is drawn. Popups use the same font.
What Gambit shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favorites, or a channel you pick.
Dark is what Gambit is designed for. System follows the TV’s own setting where it has one; Light suits a bright room.
Looks for a new version each time Gambit starts and tells you when there is one. Nothing is installed without asking.
Use %1$s in Gambit, whatever language the TV is set to.
Gambit follows the language of the TV (now %1$s). Pick one below to use it in Gambit only.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, Gambit stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and Gambit will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.
Send all Gambit traffic and playback through an HTTP proxy.
This device does not allow Gambit to set exact alarms, so a recording may begin a few minutes late. Recordings start earlier to make up for it.

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your Gambit backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
Gambit could not work out how many channels this provider allows.

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so Gambit finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, Gambit still falls back to stereo and tells you.
Gambit is a player \u2014 bring your own Xtream, M3U, or Stalker source.
Gambit is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.
